title: fagara tragodes
intro: Fagara tragodes, commonly known as Chinese prickly ash, is a plant species in the family Rutaceae. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and aiding in the relief of respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Fagara tragodes include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Fagara tragodes include alkaloids, volatile oils, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
